# Psalm 126 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 126:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Great-things has-done YHWH with-us; we-are glad.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD has done great things for us; we are glad.
- **PNEUMA:** Yes — the LORD has done incredible things for us! We are overjoyed!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 126:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Those-sowing in-tears, with-singing will-reap.
- **LOGOS:** Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy!
- **PNEUMA:** Those who plant seeds with tears will harvest with shouts of joy!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 126:2 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Then was-filled-with laughter our-mouth, and-our-tongue with-singing; then they-said among-the-nations, 'Great-things has-done YHWH with-these.'
- **LOGOS:** Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with shouts of joy; then they said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."
- **PNEUMA:** Our mouths were full of laughter and our tongues were shouting for joy! Even the other nations said, 'The LORD has done incredible things for them!'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 126:1 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. When-restored YHWH the-fortunes-of Zion, we-were like-dreamers.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. When the LORD brought us back to Zion, it was like waking from a dream.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 126:6 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** Going he-goes and-weeping, bearing the-bag-of seed; coming he-will-come with-singing, bearing his-sheaves.
- **LOGOS:** He who goes out weeping, bearing the seed for sowing, shall come home with shouts of joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
- **PNEUMA:** The farmer goes out crying, carrying his bag of seed. But he comes home singing, carrying an armload of grain!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 126:4 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** Restore O-YHWH our-fortunes, like-streams in-the-Negev.
- **LOGOS:** Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like streams in the Negeb!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, restore our fortunes again, like rain filling the dry riverbeds of the Negev!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
